integrity: The arbitrary-depth theorem follows from an explicit proof. Finite BFS tests for depth 2 through 9 are reproducible supporting checks, not exhaustive evidence for unbounded depth. No external independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula concerns only the complete binary prefix code obtained by refining the single all-one leaf, and the literal decoder rather than the minimal automaton. It makes no claim for other leaf positions. Independent scientific validation and exhaustive historical-priority research are outstanding; the full Biskup-Plandowski 2009 article was inaccessible.
title: Exact reset threshold for a single-leaf refinement of uniform binary prefix codes
